note: WIST-1 sections 5.1 and 5.2: check each entry's kid against its thumbprint and its window, authenticate sig.key_id against previous signing/recovery and incoming signing entries, and classify the verified public key by previous set membership. A null stored value tests the initial self-signed Declaration. A public key listed twice is WIST1-E08; a kid that is not its entry's thumbprint is WIST1-E14.
